record_body:
Overview
- EU-based digital media/publishing group. Multiple editorial teams across DE/FR/NL; content ops + customer support org.
- Started as self-serve Hosted API (EU traffic), then hit internal compliance gate once usage expanded from one product team to 4+.

PLG-to-sales signal context (why we’re here)
- Signal type: Regional growth + data residency intent
  - EU usage ramped and sustained; multiple workspaces created within ~2 weeks.
  - Docs intent: repeated views of “Private/VPC deployment” + security FAQ pages.
  - Notes from routing: “EMEA ownership per residency intent + EU HQ; prioritize residency clarification before pricing.”
- Signal routed to HubSpot as task on 2025-05-18; owner assigned to Lukas (EMEA). (Ref: linked Gmail thread on EU routing rules.)

Firmographics / current stack
- Current infra: AWS + some on-prem editorial systems; prefers EU regions only.
- Current LLM usage: mix of hosted APIs (not Redwood) + internal experiments.
- Procurement pattern: security review first, then budget approval with CIO.

Use case(s) / workload
- Primary workloads
  - Article summarization + metadata extraction for newsroom (batch + near-real-time).
  - Semantic search over archives (embeddings + reranking).
  - Support-agent assist for subscriber support team (chat; needs guardrails).
- Traffic
  - Editorial: daytime spikes (CET), batch jobs overnight.
  - Support: steady weekday volume.

Requirements (as captured so far)
- Data residency
  - “EU-only” requirement stated, but needs clarification: processing EU-only is non-negotiable; storage EU-only is preferred; support access must be tightly controlled.
  - They asked specifically about:
    - Where prompts/completions are processed
    - Where logs are stored (and for how long)
    - Whether support engineers can access payloads by default
- Security/compliance
  - Wants SOC 2 evidence, audit logs, and retention controls.
  - SSO/SAML is a must for production.
  - KMS support / customer-managed keys: asked as “nice to have” (security team pushing).
- Reliability/performance
  - Latency sensitivity for support-agent (target <800ms first token in EU; streaming ok).
  - For embeddings/search, wants predictable throughput + cost controls.

Sales notes (internal)
- This is not a pure “scale = Dedicated” motion yet; it’s primarily residency + governance.
- Possible path:
  1) Short security + residency workshop (30 min) to define what they mean by “EU-only.”
  2) If Hosted API in EU region satisfies, propose Hosted + compliance add-ons + SSO.
  3) If VPC isolation required, scope Redwood Private (VPC) or Dedicated EU pool depending on policy.
- They are sensitive to noisy outreach. One earlier email from an SDR (before routing suppression was tuned) was perceived as “pushy.” (Ref: SUP-3392 was used as comms template for apology/clarification; no ongoing support issue.)

Timeline (recent)
- 2025-05-18: PLG signal routed (EU residency intent). HubSpot task created; ownership assigned to Lukas (EMEA). Linked thread: 20250518-eu-data-residency-signal-routing-rules.
- 2025-05-23: Lukas sent intro + offered residency clarification call; Snowfield replied asking for written statement on data processing location + log retention defaults.
- 2025-06-03: Markus looped in for technical validation; sent security FAQ + asked for their required retention period and audit log format.
- 2025-06-12: Call held (Fireflies ff-2025-06-12-snowfield-media-residency-and-traffic-review). Key quote: “We can’t have any US-region processing; legal will block it immediately.”
- 2025-06-18: Follow-up: Snowfield asked whether Private deployment supports EU-only support access + break-glass policy; requested DPA/SCC language early.

Open questions
- Does “EU-only” include Redwood support access (i.e., EU-based support engineers only)?
- Is VPC/Private mandatory, or can they accept Hosted API if processing + logs are EU-only and retention is configurable?
- Required audit log export target (Splunk vs Datadog vs S3) and retention period.

Next steps (next 7–10 days)
- Markus: run EU-region latency/throughput baseline and share a one-pager with assumptions (sequence lengths, concurrency, model candidates).
- Lukas: schedule a 30-min residency definition workshop with Snowfield Security + Legal; bring Dr. Aisha Rahman if they ask for formal statements.
- Prepare: DPA/SCC packet + residency statement draft + outline of retention controls and default logging behavior.

Internal routing + hygiene
- Suppression: do not enroll in parallel marketing nurture while AE/SE security thread is active (avoid duplicate touches).
- Outcome tracking: if they accept Hosted EU posture, mark as “evaluation started”; if they require VPC/Private, create opp with product = Private and stage = discovery.
